headerDisplay: Choose how Homebridge connects to your entrance. Settings below follow the selected connection.
footerDisplay: Video has no two-way audio. Credentials are saved in Homebridge configuration.

username.title: Fermax Username (Email) (required)
username.description: The email address you use to log into the Fermax Blue or DuoxMe mobile app.

password.title: Fermax Password (required)
password.description: Stored as plaintext in Homebridge configuration. Restrict config file access and use a dedicated invited Fermax account.

name.title: Accessory Name in HomeKit
name.description: Shown in Apple Home for either connection.

deviceId.title: Device ID (Optional)
deviceId.description: Exact paired device ID. Required when the account has multiple monitors. An explicit mismatch fails setup.

deviceTag.title: Device Tag (Optional)
deviceTag.description: Alternative exact monitor tag; it must match one monitor. If both ID and tag are set they must identify the same monitor.

accessDoorKey.title: Door Key (Optional)
accessDoorKey.description: Exact access door key such as ZERO. Multiple doors require an explicit key or index; a mismatch fails setup.

doorIndex.title: Door Index (Optional)
doorIndex.description: Legacy manual JSON selector. Prefer the stable door key in Settings.

cameraStreamUrl.title: Camera Stream URL
cameraStreamUrl.description: Optional override for a tested FFmpeg source. Leave blank to use the selected HA camera. DUOX PLUS has no verified generic RTSP address.

cameraSnapshotUrl.title: Snapshot URL (Optional)
cameraSnapshotUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) JPEG source. Overrides the selected HA camera or direct photocaller snapshot. A snapshot alone does not provide live video.

cameraForceTranscode.title: Transcode external video
cameraForceTranscode.description: Keep enabled to meet Apple Home video requests. Disable only for a compatible H.264 source; resolution and bitrate then remain controlled by that source.

cameraStreamOptions.title: Extra FFmpeg Options (Advanced)
cameraStreamOptions.description: Additional FFmpeg input arguments. For RTSP streams, try: -rtsp_transport tcp

cameraMaxBitrate.title: Maximum Video Bitrate (kbps)
cameraMaxBitrate.description: Upper limit when transcoding. Apple Home may request a lower bitrate. Default: 2000 kbps.

unlockResetSeconds.title: Door release display reset (seconds)
unlockResetSeconds.description: Reset the displayed release state after this delay. This is a timer, not a physical door-position sensor; the plugin cannot remotely secure the door.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg Binary Path (Advanced)
ffmpegPath.description: Override the auto-detected FFmpeg path. Only needed if FFmpeg is installed in a non-standard location.

cameraDebug.title: Report FFmpeg activity
cameraDebug.description: Requires Homebridge debug logging. Reports generic activity only; media URLs and credentials are withheld.

clientId.title: App OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Use the current credentials from the official DuoxMe app. Enter both fields together. The old built-in credentials are unverified.

clientSecret.title: App OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Use the current credentials from the official DuoxMe app. Enter both fields together. The old built-in credentials are unverified.

backend.title: Connection
backend.description: Home Assistant supplies cloud video through its Fermax integration. Direct mode uses your Fermax account; current app OAuth credentials are recommended. Changing connection clears its previous fields when saved.

firebaseProjectId.title: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.description: From the official app Firebase configuration. All three fields are required to enable experimental direct alerts.

firebaseAppId.title: Firebase app ID
firebaseAppId.description: From the official app Firebase configuration. All three fields are required to enable experimental direct alerts.

firebaseApiKey.title: Firebase API key
firebaseApiKey.description: From the official app Firebase configuration. All three fields are required to enable experimental direct alerts.

firebaseVapidKey.title: Firebase VAPID key (if needed)
firebaseVapidKey.description: Optional app Firebase VAPID key, only if its registration requires one.

homeAssistantUrl.title: Home Assistant URL (required)
homeAssistantUrl.description: Server origin reachable from Homebridge, e.g. https://ha.example.com.

homeAssistantToken.title: Home Assistant access token (required)
homeAssistantToken.description: Long-lived bearer token; stored in Homebridge config. Use a dedicated HA user and protect this file.

homeAssistantLockEntity.title: Door lock entity (required)
homeAssistantLockEntity.description: Exact lock entity, e.g. lock.entrance. No automatic fallback.

homeAssistantRingEntity.title: Doorbell event entity
homeAssistantRingEntity.description: Optional. Use the actual doorbell event, or an older ring sensor. Leave blank for door release without alerts.

homeAssistantCameraEntity.title: Camera entity
homeAssistantCameraEntity.description: Optional. Adds snapshots and authenticated cloud video. Leave blank for door release without a camera.

homeAssistantPreviewEntity.title: Camera preview button
homeAssistantPreviewEntity.description: Optional preview button from the HA Fermax integration. Wakes video when Apple Home opens the selected camera.

fermaxBaseUrl.title: Fermax API origin
fermaxBaseUrl.description: Direct mode. Only reviewed current/legacy Fermax HTTPS service hosts are accepted.

fermaxAuthUrl.title: Fermax OAuth URL
fermaxAuthUrl.description: Direct mode. Only reviewed current/legacy Fermax HTTPS service hosts are accepted.

layout.title: Select an entrance
layout.description: Leave blank only when the account has one monitor and one door. Multiple entrances need an exact selector.

layout.title: Experimental direct alerts
layout.description: Use a dedicated invited user. Requires app Firebase configuration; cloud registration may reject this client.

layout.title: Camera sources
layout.description: Optional overrides. A snapshot source alone does not provide live video.
